summary: A worker who knows both press staffs can help them coordinate a surrogate's appearance.
realLife: Perlmeter described cooperation between the press offices in 1952 and recalled Clayton Fritchey's move from Truman's staff to Adlai Stevenson's campaign.
inGame: needs: a shared staff contact and a joint appearance.

turns.what: Both offices confirm the same announcement through that person.
turns.writesBack: The local press gets one account of the arrangements.

turns.what: The two desks confirm the details directly.
turns.writesBack: Neither office has to guess what the other promised.
